units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 75a:16">B. Bath. 75ᵃ</cite> <he>אוי לה לאותה ב׳</he> Oh, for that shame! <cite ref="Zevachim 113a:16">Zeb. 113ᵃ</cite>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 7:5:3">Y. Shebu. VII, 38ᵃ</cite> top <he>מפני הב׳</he> in order that they should be ashamed of each other (to swear falsely).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 5:4:3">Y. Ned. V, 39ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני הב׳</he> in order to make reparation for putting his neighbor to shame; a. fr.
